repo.description: The most widely used Python to C compiler
repo.name: cython

body:
Teaches Cython about Python's exception class hierarchy and allows it to infer a concrete exception (base) type as spanning type for two given exceptions.

Moves the long list of known builtin type names from `Code.py` (where it always felt awkward) to `PyrexTypes.py`. `Builtin.py` might seem better but introduces import order issues since the list is used in other modules that `Builtin.py` depends on. It now lives right before `BuiltinObjectType` in `PyrexTypes.py`, which seems sufficiently appropriate.

I also moved `uncachable_builtins` with it to help keeping that set in sight of the known builtins.
I wonder if `renamed_py2_builtins_map` should be moved as well. It's not going to change any more.

comment_data.body:
> We can still optimise if we find the exact type at runtime. I'll add a bit of that.

Yeah that does make sense for the concrete exception types. I'd thought it was practically very unlikely to hit for `Exception` but something like `KeyError` is probably almost always a `KeyError` and not a base class

commit.message: Allow C property setters to raise exceptions.
Allow either 'void' or 'int' error return for C property setters.
Extend "declare_cproperty()" helper for creating writable C properties.
Fix test.
Require explicit "noexcept" for 'void' setters and "except(?) -1" for setters with 'int' return.
Let Cython know about Python's exception type hierarchy.
Infer the concrete exception base type as spanning type for two given exceptions.
Fix test.
Clean up, fix and extend tests.
Tests: Wrap long lines.
Extend test.
Fix code style.
Implement ".args" of builtin exceptions as C property.
Add missing utility code dependency.
Update documentation.
Allow C property setters for builtins.
Include more exception properties and enable them also for known direct subtypes via additional type pointer comparisons.
Fix exception MRO dict building in PyPy/GraalPy, which evaluate dict.update(genexpr) lazily.
Use more appropriate object struct name in test.
Fix type inference for 'except' clause target.
Fix copy&paste.
Fix type pointer type.
Unify the utility code implementation with Tempita to reduce code duplication and share the same optimisations.
Add more known (object) properties.

Revert "Use more appropriate object struct name in test."

This reverts commit 11344d515c4444fa104ba73a3f4240df253dfabc.
Restrict fast access to name/obj properties of NameError and AttributeError to Py3.10+ where they originated.
Merge branch 'master' into infer_exc_subtypes

milestone.description:
Main features:
- Pattern matching
- Generics / subscripted container types
- `@cython.collection_type()`
- `restrict`
- more vectorcalls
- more thread safety
- smaller modules, more shared code
- remove Py3.8 support, keep Py3.9+
